request:
镜头 s09：纪录片现场纪实镜头，时长 10 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-lab50s）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['Super 16', 'Vision3 500T']）：Locked look "2050s institute film archive" (style preset sp01-lab50s): an Arriflex 416 Super 16 camera; Kodak Vision3 500T 7219 pushed one stop; a 12-120mm documentary zoom at f/2.8; filter none; grade: muted, desaturated, a green-cyan fluorescent cast with one warm practical; light: cold fluorescent tubes plus one warm desk lamp, deep shadows; texture: lively Super 16 grain, slightly soft resolution; the institute's own observational record, watching people work from across the room.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：fly-on-the-wall documentary camera, shoulder-mounted handheld with small reframings, operator reacting late
导演意图（自然语言）：手持中景，轻微晃动。宋工把铁盒举到波爷面前，认真地解释；波爷探身过来，皱着眉打量这只盒子。环境声：机房嗡鸣、远处的空调声。
情绪：earnest, curious, sceptical
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium two-shot, shoulder-mounted handheld with small reframings
景深与虚实：Moderate depth of field: both faces and the box sharp, the server hall behind the glass soft.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Handheld documentary two-shot at night in the lab: Song holds up the dented tin box with its antenna toward Boye, a 44-year-old man in black-framed glasses and a navy quilted jacket, who leans in sceptically over the workbench; desk lamp light, the glass wall with the red lens behind them. Blocking lock: Song stands at frame left holding the tin box up at chest height, Boye leans in from frame right over the workbench; the glass wall and the red lens glow in the background centre.
Picture 2: Engineer Song (Song Qi, 33 in 2048, systems engineer on the 550 quantum-computer project) (character reference; role: the protagonist). A 33-year-old Chinese man, systems engineer on a national quantum-computer project. Slim, medium height, short neat black hair with a side parting, clean-shaven, a small mole under his right eye, warm attentive eyes with faint laugh lines, thin round steel-rimmed glasses. Light-grey knitted cardigan over a pale blue collared work shirt, a blank white ID card on a dark lanyard, a cheap black digital wristwatch on his left wrist.
Picture 3: Boye at 44 (Song's colleague, network protocol engineer, in the 2050s) (character reference; role: Song's colleague). A 44-year-old Chinese man, network protocol engineer: short black hair with the first grey streaks, dark stubble, intact black-framed glasses, a broad nose and a stubborn mouth. Dark navy quilted work jacket over a brown knitted vest.
Picture 4: Song's prototype node (the dented tin box, still without a sticker) (prop reference; role: prop reference). A handmade prototype network node: an old dented steel tin box with a plain scratched olive-grey lid, a salvaged circuit board, a small heat sink, three tiny LEDs and a short screw-on antenna, on a cluttered lab workbench under a desk lamp. No sticker on the lid.
Picture 5: the 550 project laboratory at night (2050s) (location reference; role: location reference). Interior of the quantum-computer laboratory of a national research institute at night in the 2050s: a long cluttered engineer's workbench with a soldering station, oscilloscopes, coils of wire, circuit boards and notebooks under a desk lamp; behind a large glass wall, a cold clean server hall with rows of tall black cabinets and, on the central black cabinet, a single round red-glowing camera lens exactly like the terminal in the reference image. Fluorescent tubes. Empty of people.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. Song (a man in his early thirties, warm and gentle voice with a smile in it) — 宋工（三十出头男性的声音，温和、带笑意）: 每台机器，自己带一把钥匙，自己证明自己是谁。
现场环境声：server hall hum, air conditioning, the faint tick of the tin box
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[rules/move/documentary-handheld] move
[ours/cam-verite-follow] 机位：纪实手持跟拍
[rules/move/handheld-slight] move
[ours/pace-doc] 节奏：纪录片的呼吸
[ours/arch-film-dust] 资料退化：胶片划痕与漏光
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 10.0s, 24fps, Locked look "2050s institute film archive" (style preset sp01-lab50s): an Arriflex 416 Super 16 camera; Kodak Vision3 500T 7219 pushed one stop; a 12-120mm documentary zoom at f/2.8; filter none; grade: muted, desaturated, a green-cyan fluorescent cast with one warm practical; light: cold fluorescent tubes plus one warm desk lamp, deep shadows; texture: lively Super 16 grain, slightly soft resolution; the institute's own observational record, watching people work from across the room; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, medium two-shot at chest height from across the workbench, shoulder-mounted handheld with small reframings, the frame drifting lightly on the operator's shoulder and correcting a half beat after each move, holding a medium two-shot of both men from start to end. pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Song stands at frame left in profile three-quarters to camera, the tin box held up at chest height in both hands; Boye at frame right leans in over the workbench toward the box; between and behind them the glass wall carries the soft rows of black cabinets and the single red-glowing lens at frame centre background. Start: Song's hands lift the box ten centimetres and rotate it slowly so the short screw-on antenna and the three tiny LEDs come round to face Boye, the warm desk lamp grazing the scratched olive-grey lid. Middle: he taps the lid twice with a fingertip, then tips the box slightly toward Boye to show the seam where the salvaged circuit board sits, the little heat sink catching a thin highlight; his glasses slide a millimetre and he pushes them back up with his knuckle, still holding the box steady with the other hand, talking all the while with a small pleased smile. End: he settles the box level at chest height again and holds it there, thumb resting on its worn edge, chin lifted, waiting; Boye has drawn back half a step over the bench, chin tucked, brow furrowed, eyes moving between the box and Song's face and not yet convinced. Mood: earnest, curious, sceptical. Blur: both faces and the tin box stay sharp; the server hall behind the glass, the far cabinets and the red lens fall into a soft glow, the fluorescent tubes above dissolving into pale green-cyan haze.
Song (a man in his early thirties, warm and gentle voice with a smile in it) says, <d>[Chinese] 每台机器，自己带一把钥匙，自己证明自己是谁。</d>
Final line of this shot: end on "自己证明自己是谁", complete the whole sentence, no cut-off; after the last line nobody speaks. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Server hall hum through the glass, steady air-conditioning drone, fluorescent tube buzz, the faint hollow tick of the tin box under a fingertip, the small rustle of a quilted jacket as Boye leans in, quiet breaths, a chair caster creaking somewhere behind; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
